name: top-loading-bar
title: Top loading bar
description: A thin bar across the top that races to 80 percent while a page or action is pending, then sweeps to the end and fades. Work shorter than a delay never shows it.
docs: Pass active from a router transition, a form action or a pending flag; mount one bar near the top of the layout. It is fixed to the viewport by default: give it className="absolute" inside a relatively positioned panel. The bar waits delay milliseconds (150 by default) before it shows, so fast work never flashes it, and it is announced once as a polite status with the label you give it. Under reduced motion it is a still line that appears and disappears. Switch tone to destructive just before a failing run ends.
